design: Dispatch once per record into const-specialized evaluation bodies; fixed-64 wide functions are separate from unchanged generic kernels. Masks are not included. Six ABBA/BAAB blocks per case following one warmup per executable; every result retained. No claim based on a selected fastest run.
limitations: Balanced neighboring comparisons reduce order bias but do not remove shared-hardware interference.
Full isolated and printed-output gates pass; complete internal snapshots and serial bootstrap integration still precede any promotion.
64-state specialization only; other shapes retain the original loop. No universal state-count or production speedup claim.
